exclusions: Reject questions that ask for a diagnosis, medical treatment, or a legal conclusion.
Do not claim individualized medical, legal, financial, or other professional guidance.
Reject causal or universal conclusions that exceed the stated evidence.
Do not turn this Topic Pack into a UI seeding feature, live directory, local listing, or answer-structure system.
prompt_context: Generate one bounded audience question from the selected axes. This Topic Pack supplies question domains only; it does not decide answer structure, act as a UI seeding feature or live directory, or provide individualized medical or legal guidance.
evidence_expectations: Keep primary sources, measurement logs, official guidance, controlled comparisons, expert explanations, and anecdotal observation distinct.
Label lived observation as anecdotal and never use it alone to support a causal or universal conclusion.
Do not invent research, a source review, professional assessment, live listing, or individualized guidance.
compatibility_rules: Reject a candidate when its normalized question duplicates an existing episode or an in-batch candidate; store the rejection reason with the candidate fingerprint.
Reject a candidate when its subject, audience-context, question-intent, and constraint tuple repeats; store the rejection reason with the candidate fingerprint.
Reject a candidate when the question asks for a diagnosis, legal conclusion, or medical treatment.
Reject a candidate when lived observation labelled as anecdotal is paired with a causal or universal conclusion.
For a retry, reuse the same seed and persisted fingerprint rejection reasons so accepted order and rejection outcomes remain deterministic.
